title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Find the maximum dimension of a family of rays that mirrors can trap in Euclidean space; in three dimensions, decide whether a non-normal two-parameter family can be trapped.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200013 (AMR-051-0013). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Serge Tabachnikov, Problem 1, pp. 9--10.
